CustomField.description: Captures Credit Note Date End Of Month
CustomField.formula: IF( MONTH(blng__CreditNoteDate__c) = 12, DATE( YEAR(blng__CreditNoteDate__c), 12, 31 ), DATE( YEAR(blng__CreditNoteDate__c), MONTH(blng__CreditNoteDate__c) + 1, 1) - 1)
CustomField.label: Credit Note Date End Of Month
